title: Llumnix: Dynamic Scheduling for Large Language Model Serving
quote: Llumnix can safely copy the KV cache of previous tokens in parallel with the computation for new tokens.
proves: Live migration relies on append-only KV; downtime is the copy of one iteration's KV, roughly 20-30 ms and constant in sequence length.
does_not_prove: No mention of speculative decoding. Rejected-token KV and draft KV are not append-only per step (writes then rollback), so the one-iteration-delta argument is unchecked for spec decode.
bearing: supports live migration of spec state as open gap

title: RLHFSpec: Breaking the Efficiency Bottleneck in RLHF Training via Adaptive Drafting
quote: the d-instance can commence the subsequent computation as soon as it receives the SSM KVCache
proves: Migrates draft (SSM=small model) and target KV separately in two stages; destination resumes drafting once draft KV arrives; combined overhead under 3.87% of execution time.
does_not_prove: RLHF rollout, not online serving; no migration-only measurement; draft model with its own KV, not EAGLE hidden states or MTP; 'near-zero' overhead claim unmeasured.

title: Nightjar: Dynamic Adaptive Speculative Decoding for Large Language Models Serving
quote: proactively disables speculative decoding
proves: Under memory strain disables spec decode and moves draft model weights to CPU to free KV; up to 14.76% throughput, 20.18% lower latency vs standard SD.
does_not_prove: Offloads draft weights, not per-request draft KV; does not address what happens to in-flight draft state of preempted requests.
bearing: partial overlap with memory-pressure-aware spec policy

title: Towards Resiliency in Large Language Model Serving with KevlarFlow
quote: background KV cache replication to maintain high throughput during partial failures
proves: Fault tolerance by replicating KV; 20x MTTR reduction (10 min to 30 s), 3.1x avg latency under failure.
does_not_prove: Abstract only read; no mention of speculative decoding, draft KV, or hidden-state replication.

title: LUMEN: Coordinated Failure Recovery for Distributed LLM Serving
quote: restore KV caches from checkpoints stored on a fixed neighboring worker
proves: Recent recovery work checkpoints KV and redistributes interrupted requests load-aware.
does_not_prove: Abstract only; no mention of speculative decoding or of whether draft state is checkpointed or rebuilt.

title: fix(v1): prevent IMA after speculative preemption (vLLM PR 49620, fixes 41190)
quote: a request can be preempted after a speculative decode frame has been dispatched but before its output returns
proves: With async scheduling, preemption mid-flight leaves stale spec output; fix discards it in units of 1+num_scheduled_spec placeholder tokens; linked crash was illegal memory access on hybrid GDN + MTP/DFlash.
does_not_prove: Open PR; fix is discard-and-recompute, so all verified-but-unreturned work is thrown away; no cost measurement of lost speculative work under preemption.

title: [Fix] disaggregation: Preserve EAGLE/MTP draft KV during CPU retraction (SGLang PR 44899)
quote: separate EAGLE/MTP pools use the same token slots without being included in that backup
proves: Before this PR, SGLang PD decode retraction to CPU saved target KV but not EAGLE/MTP draft KV, so draft history was overwritten by other requests; outputs stay correct but acceptance drops.
does_not_prove: Open PR, 3 days old; explicitly excludes fused draft storage, Frozen-KV MTP, DFlash, recurrent state; no measured acceptance loss.
bearing: supports: preempt/swap of draft state is live, unmeasured

title: Preserve full DFlash draft KV during PD CPU retraction (SGLang PR 39749)
quote: the resumed request drafts against another request's KV and its acceptance rate drops
proves: Same silent acceptance loss for DFlash draft KV after retraction; host_pool backend already carries draft KV as a DRAFT sidecar pool.
does_not_prove: Open; only CPU unit tests; magnitude of acceptance loss never measured.
bearing: supports measurement candidate on silent acceptance loss

title: Fix PD retraction checkpoint boundaries with overlap decoding (SGLang PR 39743)
quote: the in-flight verify commits a whole accepted block into KV and draft state, but those tokens never reach `output_ids`
proves: With overlap scheduling, retraction checkpoint can be one step ahead: recurrent state advances twice on resume, and spec-decode requests skip tokens or end early (correctness bug).
does_not_prove: Open; a fix by draining pending results first; no general model of checkpoint consistency for spec + recurrent state.

title: Fix EAGLE chunked-prefill next prompt token for resumed requests with output (SGLang PR 28254)
quote: fell back to the speculatively predicted token instead of the already-known fill token, corrupting the draft KV for that chunk
proves: Retracted-then-resumed requests re-prefill origin+output; EAGLE draft KV was rebuilt wrongly at chunk boundaries in output region.
does_not_prove: Open since June; acceptance impact not measured.
bearing: supports: recompute-on-resume path for draft state is fragile

title: [PD] Transfer EAGLE draft probabilities for rejection sampling (SGLang PR 40953)
quote: Top-k candidates alone do not provide the proposal probabilities needed by the verifier.
proves: PD handoff must carry the FP32 draft distribution for lossless stochastic rejection sampling; restricted to single-layer EAGLE.
does_not_prove: Draft PR; GPU transport and sampling quality not validated; metadata size cost reported only qualitatively.

title: fix(dflash): reject unsupported PD disaggregation (SGLang PR 36277)
quote: The existing PD wire format transfers target KV state and EAGLE-style final hidden state, but not DFLASH's per-layer draft state.
proves: SGLang PD carries EAGLE final hidden state but not DFlash per-layer draft state; combination crashed or hung, now rejected at startup.
does_not_prove: Guard, not support; no design for per-layer draft state transfer.
bearing: supports PD transfer of non-EAGLE draft state as gap

title: DSpark speculative decoding incompatible with NIXL P/D disaggregation and Hopper FA3 (vLLM issue 48221)
quote: DSpark adds `is_eagle_group=True` KV cache layers for the draft model attention. Prefill has fewer KV layers than decode.
proves: Draft KV layers must exist on both P and D; decode-only drafter fails NIXL handshake (layer count mismatch); both-sides config crashes on FA3.
does_not_prove: Open bug report; no measurement of draft KV transfer size or whether D could rebuild draft KV locally instead.
bearing: supports P-vs-D draft KV placement candidate

title: [Bugfix][Core][Spec Decode] Skip spec-decode block reservation on the external-KV-load step (P/D) (vLLM PR 50173)
quote: The prefill transfers N prompt blocks, but the scheduler will reserve N+1 (MTP1) blocks on the decode node.
proves: MTP lookahead and pad_spec_decode over-allocate on decode during KV import and trip a connector assert (DeepSeek-R1, 1P1D, MoRIIO).
does_not_prove: Bookkeeping fix only.
bearing: weak; shows lookahead slots leak into transfer accounting

title: [Core][PD] Role-aware optimizations for Spec decoding (vLLM PR 45280)
quote: P should prefill both target and drafter, D should only allocate blocks for transferring prefilled model+drafter
proves: vLLM direction: prefill instance runs drafter prefill with num_speculative_tokens=1 and no lookahead; draft KV for all layers is transferred to decode.
does_not_prove: Open; no cost comparison of transferring draft KV vs recomputing it on D.

title: [RFC]: Disaggregated Speculative Decoding with Standalone Parallel Draft Model (vLLM issue 42109)
quote: The target sends a *verification outcome* after each step; the draft server returns *K draft tokens per request*
proves: Proposes separate draft server with speculation cache, N:M verify/draft servers; claims draft adds 10-30% per-step latency when colocated.
does_not_prove: RFC with internal POC; no failure, migration, or preemption handling for draft server state described.

title: Dynamo Known Issues (v1.3.0: Disagg Decode + EAGLE3 Speculative Decoding Crashes Silently)
quote: In a disaggregated deployment, EAGLE3 speculative decoding crashes silently under large KV-transfer volume
proves: EAGLE3 + PD on vLLM backend was unsupported in Dynamo v1.3.0, fix targeted v1.4.0.
does_not_prove: Root cause not stated; whether fixed upstream not shown.
bearing: shows PD+EAGLE fragility in production stacks

title: [Bugfix][V1] Retain the EAGLE hit blocks below a sliding window across a KV connector import (vLLM PR 61011)
quote: Every later request whose prompt is longer than the window misses on all layers
proves: On P/D decode, imported SWA DFlash draft group has 32 blocks but EAGLE hit needs 33; zero draft hit zeroes the target hit too.
does_not_prove: Prefix-cache hit-rate loss not quantified in throughput.

title: [Fix] hicache: Count the EAGLE bigram boundary token in PD decode restores (SGLang PR 45076)
quote: every request that hits L2 or L3 is aborted ("HiCache restore failed")
proves: EAGLE radix keys are bigrams (N positions keyed by N+1 tokens); restore from host/storage tiers off-by-one aborted every L2/L3 hit in PD decode.
does_not_prove: One-line fix; shows tiered restore and EAGLE keying interact, not cost.
bearing: supports offload/restore + spec as active bug area

title: [RFC]: Lookahead-aware prefix-cache hashing for EAGLE-style draft models (vLLM issue 50438)
quote: all of these EAGLE-style draft methods conservatively drop the last matched unit and recompute it
proves: EAGLE draft KV at a block boundary depends on the next token, so cached draft KV is not keyed by block tokens alone; vLLM drops one block per hit.
does_not_prove: RFC; no measured cost of the dropped block.

title: [Bug]: [SpecDecode] Hybrid Mamba (align) corrupts under speculative decoding when a KV connector is attached (vLLM issue 53505)
quote: Hybrid Mamba (align) corrupts under speculative decoding when a KV connector is attached — even with zero retrieved tokens
proves: Hybrid Mamba + spec decode + KV connector produced corrupted output.
does_not_prove: Closed; quote is the issue title; body mostly environment; root cause addressed partly by PR 54165.

title: [Bugfix][Spec Decode] Restore hybrid mamba align cache hits under spec decode with a KV connector (vLLM PR 54165)
quote: misclassify DFlash/DSpark as eagle-family drafters and corrupt or degrade the mamba align prefix cache
proves: Three deterministic defects on spec + hybrid mamba + KV connector path; drafter type changes which block is safe to restore.
does_not_prove: Did not reproduce the LMCache corruption; related, not full fix.

title: Garbage output with MTP speculative decoding on long prompts (LMCache issue 4345)
quote: When MTP speculative decoding is enabled (num_speculative_tokens=2), LMCache returns corrupt KV tensors for long prompts.
proves: Silent garbage output with LMCache + MTP on ~3000-token prompts; disabling LMCache fixes it.
does_not_prove: Open; root cause unknown in body read.

title: [BUG] Hybrid Mamba/GDN + MTP5: mixed local+external prefix hit ... deterministic spec-decode degeneration (LMCache issue 5675)
quote: the resumed recurrent state behaves **prompt-independent**, i.e. most likely **all-zero / never written** rather than stale
proves: Mixed local+external prefix hit on GDN hybrid + MTP5 gives acceptance exactly 1.00 (0/~1100 drafted accepted) and garbage output.
does_not_prove: Open; root cause not found; single setup on 2080Ti.
bearing: supports recurrent-state restore + spec as unsolved

title: [Bug]: CPU offloading fails with block_size=256 + speculative decoding due to eagle group block_size mismatch (vLLM issue 48919)
quote: CPU offloading fails with block_size=256 + speculative decoding due to eagle group block_size mismatch
proves: Draft (eagle group) KV has its own block geometry that the CPU offload connector does not handle; crash at init; works with block_size=128.
does_not_prove: Config bug, not a design study.
bearing: weak; draft KV as distinct offload object

title: ReplaySSM: Cache SSM Inputs, Not State
quote: rolling back rejected draft tokens only requires removing their buffer entries
proves: vLLM's baseline stores a separate SSM state per speculative token; caching inputs instead gives 1.87-1.96x over standard decode, up to 2.14x over baseline spec path, 3.0-3.3x more concurrent requests.
does_not_prove: No mention of preemption, prefix caching, or PD; replay ring is new per-request state that must survive those.
bearing: threatens per-position-checkpoint candidates; opens ring-state lifecycle

title: [WIP][ReplaySSM] Support prefix caching for GDN speculative decode (vLLM PR 56466)
quote: keep ReplaySSM metadata and cursors consistent across cache hits, block reuse and preemption
proves: Prototype makes replay ring survive prefix caching and preemption; 360/360 requests, 585 real preemptions, zero errors (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MTP=3, 2xH200).
does_not_prove: WIP; correctness only, no cost of preemption with ring state; not PD or migration.

title: [Spec Decode][Qwen3.5] RecoverSSM for Qwen3.5 / Qwen3-Next GDN (vLLM PR 61309)
quote: +8.6% output throughput at K=5
proves: RecoverSSM verify/commit path for Qwen GDN + MTP; +8.6% throughput at K=5, c=32 on Qwen3.5-4B, L40S, acceptance unchanged.
does_not_prove: Open; small model; interaction with preemption/offload not covered.
bearing: rollback mechanism is moving fast upstream

title: [Feat] [NVIDIA] mamba2: Add compact speculative-state replay (SGLang PR 41968)
quote: Reduce Mamba2 speculative-decoding memory by replacing full candidate-state snapshots with compact input records.
proves: SGLang port of replay idea for Mamba2 spec; explicitly unsupported with PD disaggregation, adaptive/ragged verification, int8 checkpoints.
does_not_prove: SM100 only, topk 1, 4 verify positions.

title: [Fix] pd: Size decode Mamba spec-state scratch by running batch, not decode extra slots (SGLang PR 44015)
quote: `intermediate_ssm_state_cache` is **20.5 GB** instead of **7.4 GB** per GPU
proves: Per-draft-position SSM scratch is fp32 [layers, slots+1, draft_tokens, ...]; on PD decode it was sized for in-transfer slots, 20.5 GB vs 7.4 GB per GPU, causing OOM.
does_not_prove: Sizing fix; shows memory scale of per-position checkpoints, not a policy.
bearing: supports memory cost of recurrent rollback state

title: [Performance]: Avoidable preemption at hybrid Attention/Mamba decode block transitions (vLLM issue 62752)
quote: The remaining capacity then forces preemption, although an alternative order completes all requests without preemption at the same pool size.
proves: CPU reproducer: with aligned Mamba + 5 spec tokens + 5 lookahead slots, FCFS block consumption causes avoidable preemptions.
does_not_prove: Opened today; simulated outputs; no throughput measurement.

title: STree: Speculative Tree Decoding for Hybrid State-Space Models
quote: extending speculative decoding to SSMs require backtracking the state, which is non-trivial at scale.
proves: Tree spec decoding for SSM/hybrid via accumulated transition matrices; 1.74-1.98x (temp 0) on RTX 3090 vs 1.69-1.93x vanilla SD; slightly slower than vanilla at temp 0 on H100.
does_not_prove: Single-request kernel study; no serving, preemption, or batching of rollback state.
bearing: rollback algorithm known; serving lifecycle open

title: The Mamba in the Llama: Distilling and Accelerating Hybrid Models
quote: The approach maintains only one RNN hidden state in cache for verification.
proves: Snapshot state before drafting and recompute on rejection; 2.1-2.6x on 3090, 1.71-2x on H100; naive version no speedup on H100.
does_not_prove: Single request; no serving-system state lifecycle.

title: SpecMamba: Accelerating Mamba Inference on FPGA with Speculative Decoding
quote: Mamba discards previous hidden states after each update, complicating state recovery when draft tokens are rejected.
proves: Names the two rollback options (store per-draft states vs cache activations and recompute); storing is prohibitive for target model.
does_not_prove: FPGA, not GPU serving.
